text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Look at all these! There's enough
to
decorate your office and the
disciplinary
committee room too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to be surrounded by rivals
everywhere I
go! My blood's already
pumping!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm taking these new rivals for a
run right
away! And don't think I'm
gonna take it easy on
them just 'cause
they're cute!
